topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: When I opened the door this morning, there it was—a package, neatly placed by the delivery person, with my address but clearly not my name. I picked it up, noticing the label had been crossed out and rewritten, probably in a hurry. Curiosity and a bit of caution made me pause before bringing it inside. I thought, maybe it's a mistake, a simple mix-up. Inside, I found a note and a few items that didn't belong to me. I wondered about the person who should have received this, imagining their disappointment at not finding their package. I decided to reach out to the sender, hoping to solve this little mystery and return the items to their rightful owner.
